title: SCE Experiment 1.5: Rogue Instance Creation - Preventive Probe
description: This Security Chaos Engineering experiment validates that preventive controls (IAM policies with explicit Deny statements) successfully block unauthorized EC2 instance creation attempts. The experiment simulates an attacker attempting to create a rogue EC2 instance with ECS configuration to join a target cluster. The preventive controls should deny the iam:PassRole action to ECS instance profiles and restrict RunInstances to approved AMIs only.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: Preventive controls block unauthorized EC2 instance creation with ECS configuration

probes.name: Verify preventive control blocked rogue instance creation

method.name: Deploy experiment infrastructure with preventive controls
Execute rogue EC2 instance creation attack
